name: pg-boss PostgreSQL Job Queue
free_limit: MIT-licensed Node.js job queue on PostgreSQL with no software-enforced job, worker, or queue quotas; supports scheduling, retries, dead-letter queues and transactional jobs.
watch_out: Requires your own PostgreSQL 13+ database and Node.js 22.12+ or Bun; database, compute, storage, backups and operations are not included. Jobs are delivered at least once; handlers must be idempotent.
